```sql
SELECT
  l.location_id,
  l.location_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN oi.is_food_item THEN oi.product_price ELSE 0 END) AS food_revenue
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" AS oi
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" AS o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."locations" AS l
  ON o.location_id = l.location_id
GROUP BY l.location_id, l.location_name
ORDER BY food_revenue DESC;
```
